title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
summary: Today Anthropic, PBC announced the closing of its initial public offering of an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a public offering price of $83.00 per share, including the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common…

title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
summary: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
summary: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.

title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
summary: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.

title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
summary: We're at the start of a major effort to speed up drug development with Claude. Over the past several months, our scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines.

title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
summary: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.

title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
summary: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
summary: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.

title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
summary: We’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025.

title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
summary: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement.

title: Investing in the public benefit
summary: We’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.

title: An update on independent evaluators
summary: To evaluate the safety of our systems, Anthropic is giving employee-like access to a team from METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models, and we're in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.

title: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with the Government of Singapore
summary: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore and signed an MOU with the country’s government to advance safe, responsible AI adoption.

title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
summary: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards. Here, we outline how we’ve continued to strengthen these safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.

title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
summary: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.

title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
summary: Anthropic is committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative to accelerate scientific and technological discovery through AI.

title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
summary: We’re launching the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term commitment to securing the systems everyone depends on.

title: 2026 Usage Policy update
summary: We’re publishing a new version of our Usage Policy. In this post, we summarize the changes we’ve made.

title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.

title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
summary: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

title: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap
summary: Anthropic is investing $100 million in Claude Frontier Academy to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, with cohorts from Accenture, Bain, CBA, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk already underway.

title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
summary: Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.

title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is a clear upgrade over Claude Sonnet 5, runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work.
